ix_deletion_pending.name: ix_deletion_pending
ix_deletion_pending.where: completed_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL

ck_attendee_sessions_reason.name: ck_attendee_sessions_reason
ck_attendee_sessions_reason.value: revoked_reason IS NULL OR revoked_reason IN ('logout','user_revoked','admin','suspension','deletion','recovery','token_reuse')

ck_payments_amounts.name: ck_payments_amounts
ck_payments_amounts.value: amount_minor >= 0 AND refunded_minor >= 0 AND refunded_minor <= amount_minor

ux_subscriptions_attendee_live.name: ux_subscriptions_attendee_live
ux_subscriptions_attendee_live.where: attendee_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('created','authenticated','active','pending')

ux_subscriptions_org_live.name: ux_subscriptions_org_live
ux_subscriptions_org_live.where: organization_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('created','authenticated','active','pending')

ck_subscriptions_subscriber.name: ck_subscriptions_subscriber
ck_subscriptions_subscriber.value: (subscriber_type = 'attendee' AND attendee_id IS NOT NULL AND organization_id IS NULL) OR (subscriber_type = 'organization' AND organization_id IS NOT NULL AND attendee_id IS NULL)
